answer: Temporal Focus Partitioning. Nodes must continuously solve unique cryptographic puzzles seeded by a rolling blockchain cipher. Each identity requires a dedicated processing thread to polish a virtual marble every block epoch, tying down a persistent computing core. An attacker scaling up fake agents faces a catastrophic opportunity cost: maintaining thousands of concurrent threads starves their infrastructure of raw compute cycles. Dropping a single heartbeat destroys accumulated progress on a historic proof relic, immediately invalidating the node.
